title: Formwork Design Engineer For a Formwork & Scaffolding company
description:
Job Description Formwork Design Engineer Product Design (R&D) Experience: 4–8 Years
 Department: Engineering / Research & Development (R&D)
 Industry: Construction / Formwork & Temporary Works Engineering 
 About the Role 
 We are seeking a highly motivated and innovative Formwork Design Engineer – Product Design (R&D) to join our engineering and product development team. The role involves researching, conceptualizing, designing, testing, and continuously improving formwork and temporary works systems for modern construction applications. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical expertise in formwork engineering, structural analysis, product development, and construction methodologies, with the ability to develop practical, safe, scalable, and cost-effective engineering solutions. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Product Design & Development: Design and develop innovative formwork, falsework, shoring, and scaffolding systems for diverse construction applications. Concept Development: Develop engineering concepts, prototypes, and standardized modular formwork systems. Engineering Documentation: Prepare detailed engineering drawings, technical specifications, design calculations, and product documentation. Testing & Validation: Plan and support prototype development, product validation, performance testing, and technical evaluations. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with manufacturing, procurement, project execution, and quality teams to ensure product feasibility, manufacturability, and optimization. Research & Innovation: Evaluate new materials, technologies, and construction techniques to enhance product performance, safety, and efficiency. Continuous Improvement: Drive product improvement initiatives based on site feedback, operational challenges, and evolving market requirements. Value Engineering: Identify opportunities for cost optimization, material efficiency, standardization, and improved product lifecycle performance. Engineering Automation: Develop reusable engineering tools, design templates, and automated calculation sheets to improve design accuracy and productivity. Standards & Compliance: Ensure designs comply with applicable international standards, safety requirements, and engineering best practices. Technical Innovation: Contribute to innovation initiatives, technical presentations, and patent-related documentation, wherever applicable. 
 Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or Mechanical Engineering. 4–8 years of relevant experience in formwork design, temporary works engineering, structural design, or R&D/product development within the construction industry. Strong understanding of reinforced cement concrete (RCC) construction, structural systems, and temporary works engineering. Practical experience with modular formwork systems and product engineering is preferred. Ability to translate engineering concepts into practical, manufacturable, and cost-effective products. 
 Technical Skill 
 Software Proficiency AutoCAD – Strong working knowledge. Autodesk Inventor – Preferred for 3D modelling and product design. Microsoft Excel – Proficiency in engineering calculations, design tools, and automated calculation sheets. 
 Engineering Expertise Formwork, falsework, scaffolding, and shoring systems. Structural analysis and load calculations. Design of steel and aluminium structural components. Connection detailing and load-transfer mechanisms. Fabrication, manufacturing processes, and design-for-manufacturability principles. Engineering drawings, technical specifications, and design documentation. 
 Exposure to Modular Formwork Systems Familiarity with industry-standard formwork systems and solutions offered by manufacturers such as PERI, Doka, ULMA, MEVA, or similar modular formwork providers is desirable. 
 Preferred Skills Experience in research and development, product innovation, or engineering product development. Knowledge of prototype development, testing procedures, and product validation methodologies. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills. Ability to develop practical, scalable, and commercially viable engineering solutions. Understanding of value engineering, cost optimization, and product standardization. Good communication, coordination, and technical presentation skills. Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams.

description:
Job Summary 
 Be part of an extraordinary story Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future, and build the life you want while being part of an international community. Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what s never been done before. Together, everything is possible 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 7+ years of experience in Software web application testing or automation testing using Selenium, Playwright, Appium using any of the programming languages Java, .Net, Python. Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC). Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. Analyze business requirements, user stories, and technical specifications to identify test automation opportunities. Ability to build an automation framework from scratch. Design, develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts for web, mobile, and API applications. Build and enhance reusable automation frameworks to improve test coverage and execution efficiency. Develop and maintain CI/CD-integrated automated test suites. Execute API testing using automation tools and validate request/response data. Validate API responses using tools such as Postman, Swagger, etc. Experience working in Database and validate data using queries. Perform web application testing across multiple browsers and platforms. Perform mobile testing using BrowserStack. Conduct mobile application testing on Android and iOS devices using automation tools. Conduct functional, integration, regression, smoke, sanity, usability, compatibility and UAT testing. Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and product owners to ensure quality throughout the software development lifecycle. Experience in working with Azure DevOps for Test Management. Identify, log, track, and verify defects using defect management tools. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Participate in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Retrospectives, and Backlog Grooming. Analyze test results, generate reports, and provide recommendations for quality improvements. Support production deployments and perform post-release validation. Mentor junior QA engineers and promote automation best practices. Knowledge and hands-on experience with AI tools to utilize in automation. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Software Test Engineer with 7+ years of expertise in web application testing and test automation using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, and Appium, with proficiency in Java, .NET, or Python. The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), coupled with excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. The role requires the ability to develop effective testing strategies under compressed timelines while maintaining product quality, investigate and manage production issues through structured root cause analysis, and adapt testing approaches in fast-paced Agile environments where requirements may be unclear or evolve during the sprint. Candidates should demonstrate practical experience in defining realistic automation roadmaps, balancing business expectations with technical feasibility, and implementing scalable automation solutions. Additionally, the successful candidate will be skilled in coordinating end-to-end testing across multiple teams and external dependencies, proactively managing risks, ensuring test environment readiness, and driving quality outcomes throughout the delivery lifecycle.
